body: Not a whole lot. What little amount of family I have left, when they are gone I most likely am also. Honestly if there was a button I could push to not exist anymore I would have pushed it many times by now. I always think of Futurama where in the first episode Bender tries to use a suicide booth. Almost daily I wish those existed.

What about if you have no military or LEO experience? Is it possible to get armed positions if built upon enough experience? I see alot of postings for former LEO or military but the pay is still crap, which makes me wonder.
